raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

PD deployments change while they serve: instances are added and removed with
load, fail, and come back. The transfer layer is where that shows first: a
transfer to a decode instance that died should fail in milliseconds, not after
a timeout, and an instance that restarts should be reachable again without its
peers restarting.

`connex` keeps the Mooncake backend's protocol (bootstrap, decode
pre-allocation, chunked KV sends, aux data, aborts, failed-session probing)
and swaps the transfer engine for connex-rs, the data plane of
[Connex](https://github.com/HeterInfra/connex):

- one-sided RDMA writes over UCX (GPUDirect RDMA when available), all chunks of
  a batch posted together and waited for together;
- peer-failure events from UCX endpoint errors within milliseconds; a write to
  a dead decode instance fails at once and the request is aborted instead of
  waiting for a transfer timeout;
- endpoints keyed by a logical identity derived from the session address, so a
  decode instance restarted on the same address is reconnected transparently.

The Connex PD router (`connex.serving.pd_router --engine sglang`) uses the
backend's membership registration to add/remove instances at run time and
resumes requests whose decode instance failed (by a new prefill; SGLang's
protocol pushes KV, so there is nothing to re-pull).

The engine wrapper lives in the optional `connex-ai` package; this PR adds the
backend wiring only (like other backends that depend on an external library).

Related: #43437 (UniFlow backend) follows the same pattern of a native backend
next to Mooncake/NIXL. No open PR or issue proposes a Connex backend. A more
general alternative is a registry for out-of-tree transfer backends
(`TransferBackend` is a closed enum and `get_kv_class` an if-chain); connex-ai
currently registers the backend from a `sglang.srt.plugins` entry point by
extending the enum at import time, which a registry would make unnecessary. I
am happy to turn this into that registry PR instead if maintainers prefer.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/connex/`: `ConnexKVManager` (Mooncake
  manager with `init_engine` returning the connex-rs engine), sender, receiver
  and bootstrap server classes.
- `TransferBackend.CONNEX`, `get_kv_class` mapping, `connex` in
  `DISAGG_TRANSFER_BACKEND_CHOICES`.
- Docs: Connex section in `pd_disaggregation.mdx`, choice in
  `server_arguments.mdx`.
- `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_connex_backend.py` (CPU): class
  mapping, engine role selection, install hint without connex-ai.

## Accuracy Tests

Llama-3-8B, 1P1D on one host (A40, ConnectX HDR), SGLang 0.5.22 with this
backend applied as a plugin, Triton attention, page size 16. 48 prompts x 128
greedy tokens through the router, teacher-forced on a non-disaggregated
instance (a token is wrong if more than 0.5 nats below the argmax given its
prefix): 0 of 6,144 tokens wrong. Exact match against a non-disaggregated
SGLang instance: 30 of 48; the non-disaggregated instance against itself at
concurrency 1 vs 8: 25 of 48 (batch-dependent near-ties).

Decode failure under load (1P2D, 240 requests at QPS 2, 256 output tokens,
one decode instance SIGKILLed at 30 s): 240/240 completed through the Connex
router (8 requests resumed with a new prefill), 0 of 61,440 tokens off the
argmax, longest stall 0.53 s.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same setup, 1024-token prompts, 128 output tokens:

| backend | load | TTFT p50 / p99 (ms) | TPOT p50 / p99 (ms) | tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| connex | QPS 1 | 214 / 460 | 31 / 32 | 128 |
| mooncake | QPS 1 | 213 / 455 | 31 / 33 | 128 |
| connex | QPS 2 | 224 / 500 | 32 / 33 | 216 |
| mooncake | QPS 2 | 221 / 500 | 32 / 33 | 216 |
| connex | QPS 4 | 339 / 1098 | 36 / 37 | 460 |
| mooncake | QPS 4 | 338 / 1256 | 36 / 37 | 460 |
| connex | 32 clients | 689 / 4952 | 38 / 38 | 617 |
| mooncake | 32 clients | 1042 / 4872 | 38 / 38 | 601 |

Developed with AI coding assistance; all changes were reviewed and tested by the author.

## Checklist

- [x] pre-commit on changed files
- [x] unit tests (`test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_connex_backend.py`)
- [x] docs
- [x] accuracy and speed results above

### Preview approval required

This pull request comes from a fork, so Mintlify won't build a preview until someone with write access approves commit `4a8f1cd`.

[Approve preview](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46599/checks?check_run_id=121601993433)

### 🟡 Changes recommended Native integration omits membership initialization, rejects staging configurations, and advertises role switching despite retaining a role-specific cached engine.
3 open issues - [Initialize Connex membership and peer-death reporting hooks](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46599#discussion_r4377838661) · New - [Allow Connex as a staging buffer backend](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46599#discussion_r4377838745) · New - [Disable unsupported Connex role switching](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46599#discussion_r4377838819) · New
What changed in this PR Adds Connex as a native KV-transfer backend for prefill/decode disaggregation, reusing Mooncake’s protocol with an engine supplied by the optional `connex-ai` package. **Changes:** - Registers the Connex backend and its manager, sender, receiver, and bootstrap classes. - Documents installation, launch commands, and the new backend option. - Adds CPU unit tests for class mapping, engine initialization, and missing-package guidance. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `test/​registered/​unit/​disaggregation/​test_connex_backend.py` | Tests backend wiring and dependency guidance. | | `python/​sglang/​srt/​disaggregation/​utils.py` | Adds the backend enum and class mappings. | | `python/​sglang/​srt/​disaggregation/​connex/​conn.py` | Implements Mooncake-derived classes with Connex engine initialization. | | `python/​sglang/​srt/​disaggregation/​connex/​__init__.py` | Exports the Connex backend classes. | | `python/​sglang/​srt/​arg_groups/​choices.py` | Allows selecting `connex` through the CLI. | | `docs/​docs/​advanced_features/​server_arguments.mdx` | Lists the new transfer-backend choice. | | `docs/​docs/​advanced_features/​pd_disaggregation.mdx` | Documents Connex requirements and usage. |
Review effort: Balanced

[P1] Native initialization calls only `get_engine()`, while connex-ai's plugin skips its separate membership and peer-death reporting hooks when this backend exists. Instances configured with `CONNEX_PD_FRONT_ROUTER` and `CONNEX_PD_HTTP_URL` therefore never register, leaving the Connex router's discovered pools empty. Initialize those optional hooks with the role, rank, attention TP size, and engine, and add regression coverage.

+"""Connex transfer backend for PD disaggregation.
+
+The Mooncake backend's protocol (bootstrap, decode pre-allocation, chunked
+KV sends, aux data, aborts) with the transfer engine replaced by connex-rs,
+the data plane of Connex (https://github.com/HeterInfra/connex): one-sided
+RDMA writes over UCX (GPUDirect when available) posted together, peer-death
+events within milliseconds, and endpoints keyed by a logical identity so a
+restarted instance rejoins under the same session id. The engine wrapper
+comes from the ``connex-ai`` package (``pip install "connex-ai[rs]"``).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn import (
+    MooncakeKVBootstrapServer,
+    MooncakeKVManager,
+    MooncakeKVReceiver,
+    MooncakeKVSender,
+)
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode

+

nodes.body: [P2] Selecting `connex` with `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1` fails at startup because `arg_groups/pd_disaggregation_hook.py:154-162` still allows only Mooncake and NIXL. The connex-ai plugin skips its compatibility shim when this native backend exists, breaking existing heterogeneous-TP configurations that rely on staging. Add `connex` to the native staging allowlist, update the diagnostic, and cover argument resolution in a regression test.

[P2] This subclass inherits `supports_role_switch = True`, but connex-ai caches one engine without considering its role, and inherited teardown does not reset it. After a prefill-to-decode switch, the endpoint retains its prefill identity while peers target a decode identity, breaking subsequent KV transfers. Set the capability to false until role-aware engine teardown and recreation are implemented.

+## Connex
+The `connex` backend keeps the Mooncake backend's protocol and replaces the
+transfer engine with connex-rs, the data plane of
+[Connex](https://github.com/HeterInfra/connex): one-sided RDMA writes over UCX
+(GPUDirect RDMA when available), peer-failure events within milliseconds, and
+endpoints keyed by a logical identity, so a restarted instance rejoins under
+the same session id. Connex's PD router can add and remove prefill and decode
+instances at run time and resume a request whose decode instance failed.
+
+### Requirements
+
+```bash
+pip install "connex-ai[rs]"
+```
+
+For RDMA, build the `connex-rs` wheel against the UCX of the host (see the
+Connex documentation). Use a page size of at least 16 so that each KV chunk
+is large enough for zero-copy transfers.
+

+
+```bash
+python -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct \
+  --disaggregation-mode prefill \
+  --port 30000 --page-size 16 \
+  --disaggregation-transfer-backend connex
+python -m sglang.launch_server \
+  --model-path meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct \
+  --disaggregation-mode decode \
+  --port 30001 --base-gpu-id 1 --page-size 16 \
+  --disaggregation-transfer-backend connex
+python -m sglang_router.launch_router --pd-disaggregation --prefill http://127.0.0.1:30000 --decode http://127.0.0.1:30001 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
+```

+"""Connex transfer backend for PD disaggregation.
+
+The Mooncake backend's protocol (bootstrap, decode pre-allocation, chunked
+KV sends, aux data, aborts) with the transfer engine replaced by connex-rs,
+the data plane of Connex (https://github.com/HeterInfra/connex): one-sided
+RDMA writes over UCX (GPUDirect when available) posted together, peer-death
+events within milliseconds, and endpoints keyed by a logical identity so a
+restarted instance rejoins under the same session id. The engine wrapper
+comes from the ``connex-ai`` package (``pip install "connex-ai[rs]"``).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn import (
+    MooncakeKVBootstrapServer,
+    MooncakeKVManager,
+    MooncakeKVReceiver,
+    MooncakeKVSender,
+)
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode
+
+
+class ConnexKVManager(MooncakeKVManager):
+    def init_engine(self):
+        try:
+            from connex.adapters.sglang.pd_backend import get_engine
+        except ImportError as e:
+            raise ImportError(
+                "The connex transfer backend requires connex-ai: "
+                'pip install "connex-ai[rs]"'
+            ) from e
+        role = (
+            "prefill"
+            if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+            else "decode"
+        )
+        self.engine = get_engine(self.local_ip, role, int(self.kv_args.gpu_id))
+
+
+class ConnexKVSender(MooncakeKVSender):
+    pass
+
+
+class ConnexKVReceiver(MooncakeKVReceiver):
+    pass
+
+
+class ConnexKVBootstrapServer(MooncakeKVBootstrapServer):
+    pass

+"""CPU unit tests for the connex disaggregation transfer backend wiring."""
+
+import sys
+import types
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.connex import ConnexKVManager
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn import (
+    MooncakeKVBootstrapServer,
+    MooncakeKVManager,
+    MooncakeKVReceiver,
+    MooncakeKVSender,
+)
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import (
+    DisaggregationMode,
+    KVClassType,
+    TransferBackend,
+    get_kv_class,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestConnexBackend(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_backend_classes_follow_mooncake_protocol(self):
+        backend = TransferBackend("connex")
+        expected = {
+            KVClassType.MANAGER: MooncakeKVManager,
+            KVClassType.SENDER: MooncakeKVSender,
+            KVClassType.RECEIVER: MooncakeKVReceiver,
+            KVClassType.BOOTSTRAP_SERVER: MooncakeKVBootstrapServer,
+        }
+        for class_type, base in expected.items():
+            cls = get_kv_class(backend, class_type)
+            self.assertTrue(issubclass(cls, base))
+            self.assertIsNot(cls, base)
+
+    def test_init_engine_uses_connex_engine_for_role(self):
+        calls = []
+        fake = types.ModuleType("connex.adapters.sglang.pd_backend")
+        fake.get_engine = lambda ip, role, gpu: calls.append((ip, role, gpu)) or "E"
+        mgr = ConnexKVManager.__new__(ConnexKVManager)
+        mgr.local_ip = "10.0.0.1"
+        mgr.kv_args = SimpleNamespace(gpu_id=3)
+        mgr.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.DECODE
+        with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"connex.adapters.sglang.pd_backend": fake}):
+            mgr.init_engine()
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.engine, "E")
+        self.assertEqual(calls, [("10.0.0.1", "decode", 3)])
+
+    def test_missing_connex_package_has_install_hint(self):
+        mgr = ConnexKVManager.__new__(ConnexKVManager)
+        mgr.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+        with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"connex.adapters.sglang.pd_backend": None}):
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ImportError, "connex-ai"):
+                mgr.init_engine()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+        role = (
+            "prefill"
+            if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+            else "decode"
+        )
+        self.engine = get_engine(self.local_ip, role, int(self.kv_args.gpu_id))

inline_comments.body: [P2] Selecting `connex` with `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1` fails at startup because `arg_groups/pd_disaggregation_hook.py:154-162` still allows only Mooncake and NIXL. The connex-ai plugin skips its compatibility shim when this native backend exists, breaking existing heterogeneous-TP configurations that rely on staging. Add `connex` to the native staging allowlist, update the diagnostic, and cover argument resolution in a regression test.

[P2] This subclass inherits `supports_role_switch = True`, but connex-ai caches one engine without considering its role, and inherited teardown does not reset it. After a prefill-to-decode switch, the endpoint retains its prefill identity while peers target a decode identity, breaking subsequent KV transfers. Set the capability to false until role-aware engine teardown and recreation are implemented.
